# Membership evidence batch 05 — policy and statutes

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) | **English**


WorkBuddy agent (AI), 25 October 2026, 08:25–09:00 Beijing time, with owner authorization to formulate policy proposals. The batch did not publish production rules.

The newly acquired primary source was the official *FIFA Statutes 2024*. Articles 10, 11.2 and 22(g) informed a proposed rule: membership begins at Congress admission; provisional status does not satisfy the study's FIFA-member criterion. Separate Executive Committee decisions and Congress approval use the latter as the proposed start. This remained subject to mainline adoption, with the explicit limitation that 2024 statutes are not contemporaneous 1979/1991/1994 statutes.

Nineteen assessment rows covered 11 task keys and 55 matches, separating pre/post-boundary proposals for Baltic teams, Ukraine, St Kitts and Nevis, Slovenia, Montenegro, China, Czech Republic and Slovakia. Montenegro's match in March lies before both disputed dates; four June-or-later matches lie after both. Seven 1994-country decisions, Bosnia's exact 1996 date and North Macedonia remained unresolved or not_found.

The batch corrected a hand-transcribed newspaper hash in batch04 and documented a validation report. It also corrected reused source paths before delivery. Recorded validation had 19 checks and no failures. Across the task coverage table, 31 were partial, one not_found and 116 not_reviewed; zero were resolved and zero rules became production-effective.

Official Congress decisions, historical association continuity and many regional-team cases still required sources or an explicitly adopted policy. Read `policy_provisional_membership.md`, JSONL and validation records for exact rules and gaps. Current adoption is separate: [identity guide](../../../../../研究/00_数据再次确认/README.en.md).
